proposed.text: A member passes bending with fb = 9 MPa and supplied Fb = 12 MPa, but fails shear with fv = 1.6 MPa and supplied Fv = 1.2 MPa. What governs the redesign?

options.text: Shear governs because fv exceeds Fv; increase area, reduce shear demand, or use a source-supported higher allowable shear value.
Bending governs because any beam check starts with moment before shear.
The member passes because at least one ASD check is acceptable.
The member can be approved if the uncited code factor is assumed to increase Fv.

rationale.correct: ASD requires each applicable stress check to satisfy demand <= allowable. Bending passes, but shear fails because 1.6 MPa > 1.2 MPa, so shear controls the redesign.
rationale.takeaway: A passing bending check does not cancel a failing shear check.
